0022600023.text: The Lakers (4-1, first in the Pacific and third in the West) visit the Warriors (2-3, second in the Pacific and 10th in the West) in a Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, the sixth of the season for Los Angeles. The Lakers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 127-105 win in Los Angeles on October 21, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1. Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (foot), while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and is a game-time decision.
